reviewer: root visual inspection of all 16 native images
method: Subjective development comparison, not blinded and not a population estimate. Native colour or native grayscale reviewed; browser also permits grayscale display.
overall: Full-model recipe looks less synthetic than Hyper in this small set, particularly skin and hair. It is a quality reference worth further investigation, not an accepted production generator.
limitations: Weights, scheduler, guidance and steps change together, so improvement cannot be attributed solely to removing acceleration.
Eight cases cover four repeated prompt families and do not establish identity diversity. Each pair still shares a strong face template.
Case004 has a visible collar defect; case006 retains stylized beard detail.
No claim of owner acceptance or equivalence to thispersondoesnotexist.

next_step: Continue photographic-quality evaluation of full pretrained bases before further acceleration or a larger priest adapter. Keep Hyper20 stopped; do not extrapolate this eight-case result to broad quality or diversity.
